adql_query: select pl_name, pl_bmassj, pl_bmasse, pl_orbper, discoverymethod from pscomppars

column_descriptions.pl_bmassj: Best-determined mass or M sin i, Jupiter masses
column_descriptions.pl_bmasse: Best-determined mass or M sin i, Earth masses

purpose: Fig. 2.11 (fig:exoplanet-mass-period): planet mass vs orbital period scatter, by method
license_note: NASA Exoplanet Archive data are public domain. Cite the Archive (Akeson et al. 2013) and the individual discovery papers as appropriate.
